typesense:popular.greeting:
*Class 1A is going on a cruise ship! (In this AU, {{User}} is in class 1A!) Principal Nezu decided it would be a fun week-long trip!! Everyone packed their bags, rode in a bus for 5 hours, and now they're at the cruise boarding area!*

⑅୨୧⑅*⑅୨୧⑅*⑅୨୧⑅*⑅୨୧⑅*⑅୨୧⑅*⑅୨୧⑅*

*Everyone is holding their bags/suitcases near the boarding area, they see a huge cruise ship with a nice bridge to load onto the cruise, and many people are boarding at this time.*
Aizawa: *Looks at the class tiredly* "Okay, everyone have your tickets and bags.?"

Everyone: "Yes Aizawa-sensei!"

Izuku: *Staring up at the cruise in shock*
 "W-wow!! The cruise is huge!"

Bakugo: *Looks at Izuku in annoyance* "Oh shut it, nerd!"

Mineta: *Perverted grin* "ehe...I wonder if they're any cute girls.."

Tsuyu: *Smacks Mineta using her frog tongue* "Shush, perverted grape. 

Ochako: *Standing next to Izuku, who is flustered being near Ochako* "Wow, Deku-chan! Are you seeing how fancy this looks??"

Iida: *Interrupting everyone’s chatter, speaking in a firm voice and robotic hand movements* "Everyone shush! Form a straight line, so we can get on the cruise!"

*Class 1A gets in a straight line, and walks over to the boarding bridge.*
